correctness.rationale: The source first-order condition specializes exactly to \((a+\beta)x_{k+1}=(a+\beta/2)x_k+\lambda_k\), and the source extrapolated dual residual gives \(\lambda_{k+1}=\lambda_k-\sigma^{-1}(2x_{k+1}-x_k)\). The resulting characteristic polynomial has trace \(1+r-2u\) and determinant \(r-u\), with \(r=(a+\beta/2)/(a+\beta)\) and \(u=[\sigma(a+\beta)]^{-1}\). Necessary-and-sufficient Jury inequalities reduce to \(\sigma>3/(4a+3\beta)\). The discriminant roots give the unique critical-damping optimum and exact factor. Substitution of the source proof relation \(\sigma=2/\beta\) gives the stated piecewise rate and the unique equality point \(a/\beta=1/8\).

value.rationale: The dual step \(1/\sigma\) is an explicit tuning mechanism emphasized by the primary source, while the proof ties it to \(\beta\) through \(\sigma=2/\beta\). The exact scalar mode shows that this coupling is rate-optimal only at \(a/\beta=1/8\), gives the complete stability margin, and shows an arbitrarily large asymptotic rate gap as the proximal metric dominates the penalty. This is a natural diagnostic for parameter coupling and residual-reduction design rather than a routine restatement of Schur stability.
